data.text: KAD-80 done on branch coda-in-init: src/cli/coda.ts draws Coda (variant B of four, chosen by the owner: three rows of half blocks, one colour, beside 'kadence vX', the first line and 'Coda keeps what you decide, and why.') only in kadence init's success message on a TTY. Tests first (test/coda.test.ts: 3 failed, then 7 passed, including init through a pipe printing no drawing); npm test 1363 passed, 1 skipped; typecheck clean; seen in a real terminal via vhs. Criterion 4 does not apply: the core was not touched, only the CLI's init message. The site renders the same character in 3D (kadence-site demo/coda).
